order_book: As of September 30, 2026, our consolidated order book stood at INR161 crores, comprising 58 ongoing projects across road, industrial, and civil works.
I have one more question, if I am not wrong, till September 30, our order book is around INR160 crores, right?
guidance: I will begin with the industry environment, followed by our business performance during H1 FY27, the financial highlights for the period, and conclude with our priorities and outlook.
Srinibas Pradhan Constructions Limited November 18, 2026 Page 8 of 12 Management: And we will achieve our target.
capex: EBITDA margin improved significantly to 22.81%, compared to 16.76% in the corresponding period last year, representing an expansion of 606 basis points.
Net profit margin improved to 14.02% compared to 9.01% last year, reflecting an expansion of 501 basis points.
risks: Srinibas Pradhan Constructions Limited November 18, 2026 Page 3 of 12 During H1 FY27, our business operations faced challenges due to the availability and rising cost of bitumen, a key raw material for road construction.
Amid these challenges, our focus on diversifying into transportation work helped support profitability and maintain healthy margins.
